# spaceman_nodes (Data Source)

Every registered node (`GET /nodes`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spaceman_nodes" "all" {}

output "connected_nodes" {
  value = [for n in data.spaceman_nodes.all.nodes : n.name if n.connected]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/provider/docs_test.go -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `nodes` (Attributes List) The nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

### Read-Only

- `agent_version` (String) The agent's version, once it connected.
- `capacity` (Number) Runs the node accepts at once.
- `connected` (Boolean) Whether the node's agent is connected now.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) The node ID (`nod_…`).
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `name` (String) Unique name.
- `state` (String) `pending`, `active`, `disabled` or `revoked`.
